review: The long-awaited Bleed ID for Meursault, since Season 5, has finally arrived and is ready to go. It can combine several roles: applying a decent amount of Bleed, dealing an impactful amount of damage and applying significant buffs to his Bloodfiend allies through the field that he blooms is the last one. Meursault can significantly boost all of the bloodfiends through his unique effects. Let’s dive into his kit to find out exactly how he does that. Starting with his Innate Passive: - Once he or his allies achieve 5 "Hardblood Armor" stacks, they gain Focused Performance, which enhances all Skills' final power and damage. This buff is permanent as long as you can activate 2 Lust Resonance. Additionally, it functions as a stagger recovery from the stagger bar. - If Meursault and The Princess of La Manchaland Rodion are on the field together, both of them gain a Damage Bonus on their Skill
